messages.content: You are a helpful assistant that rewrites GNU C++14 code into functionally equivalent variants. The code reads and writes I/O from the console.

<perturbed_code_1>
#include <bits/stdc++.h>
 
using namespace std;
 
const int M = 1e9 + 7;
 
int main() {
    int k, p;
    cin >> p >> k;
    int cnt;
    if(k == 0) {
        cnt = p - 1;
    } else if(k == 1) {
        cnt = p;
    } else {
        cnt = 0;
        vector<bool> vis(p, false);
        for(int i = 1; i < p; i++) {
            if(!vis[i]) {
                vis[i] = true;
                cnt++;
                for(int j = i * 1ll * k % p; !vis[j]; j = (j * 1ll * k) % p) {
                    vis[j] = true;
                }
            }
        }
    }
    int ans = 1;
    for(int j = 0; j < cnt; j++) {
        ans = (ans * 1ll * p) % M;
    }
    cout << ans;
}
